### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.

[AB_2_3_Card_03]

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

#### [Vision Language Models for Axillary Lymph Nodes][83]

This study evaluated the performance of vision-language models with image-only diagnostic input for
detecting malignancy in biopsied axillary lymph nodes in patients with breast cancer.
Peng He ... Fang-Meng Fu
[article cover]

#### [Super-Resolution DLR for Coronary Stents on CTA][84]

The novel super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction algorithm improves the performance of
coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.
Cheng Xu ... Yining Wang
[article cover]

#### [Diabetes Medications and FDG PET Preparation][85]

This *AJR* Expert Panel Narrative Review examines the effects of hyperglycemia and insulin exposure
on [¹⁸F]FDG biodistribution and proposes preparation strategies for patients undergoing oncologic
[¹⁸F]FDG PET.
Philipose G. Mulugeta ... Margo Hudson
[article cover]

#### [Patient Cost-Sharing in Medicare Advantage Plans][86]

Patient cost-sharing for outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging varied across Medicare Advantage
plans, with the emergence of a small percentage of plans having outlier high coinsurance rates or
copayment amounts.
Jessica I. Billig ... Joshua M. Liao
[article cover]

#### [PSMA PET Radiopharmaceuticals][87]

This Special Series Review takes an evidence-based approach to provide insights into clinically
relevant similarities and differences of FDA-approved and late-stage research PSMA PET
radiopharmaceuticals.
Justin G. Peacock ... Phillip H. Kuo
[article cover]

#### [Vision Language Models for Axillary Lymph Nodes][83]

This study evaluated the performance of vision-language models with image-only diagnostic input for
detecting malignancy in biopsied axillary lymph nodes in patients with breast cancer.
Peng He ... Fang-Meng Fu
[article cover]

#### [Super-Resolution DLR for Coronary Stents on CTA][84]

The novel super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction algorithm improves the performance of
coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.
Cheng Xu ... Yining Wang
[article cover]

#### [Diabetes Medications and FDG PET Preparation][85]

This *AJR* Expert Panel Narrative Review examines the effects of hyperglycemia and insulin exposure
on [¹⁸F]FDG biodistribution and proposes preparation strategies for patients undergoing oncologic
[¹⁸F]FDG PET.
Philipose G. Mulugeta ... Margo Hudson
[article cover]

#### [Patient Cost-Sharing in Medicare Advantage Plans][86]

Patient cost-sharing for outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging varied across Medicare Advantage
plans, with the emergence of a small percentage of plans having outlier high coinsurance rates or
copayment amounts.
Jessica I. Billig ... Joshua M. Liao
[article cover]

#### [PSMA PET Radiopharmaceuticals][87]

This Special Series Review takes an evidence-based approach to provide insights into clinically
relevant similarities and differences of FDA-approved and late-stage research PSMA PET
radiopharmaceuticals.
Justin G. Peacock ... Phillip H. Kuo
[article cover]

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[podcast ]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[Guide PME]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

[Accéder][77]

## Consultations publiques et tests de marché en cours

Dans le cadre de l'instruction des dossiers ou l'élaboration de documents, l'Autorité de la
concurrence sollicite les observations des acteurs concernés.
* ### Étude relative aux orientations informelles en matière de développement durable
  * Energie / Environnement
  
  Ouvert jusqu’au
  31
  juillet
  2026

[Voir les consultations en cours ][78]

## La concurrence et vous

[rapport annuel 2025]
Rapport annuel

### Rapport annuel 2025

Retrouvez le rapport annuel 2025 de l'Autorité de la concurrence.

[ En savoir plus ][79]
[
[logo 15 ans sans RS]
][80]

## Les 15 ans de l'Autorité de la concurrence

L’Autorité fêtait ses 15 ans le 5 novembre 2024, dans le cadre d’un événement placé sous le haut
patronage du Président de la République.

[
[eco]
][81]

## Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN)

Créé en mai 2004, le Réseau européen de concurrence (ECN) fête cette année son 20ème anniversaire.
Entre mai 2004 et décembre 2023, les autorités nationales de concurrence ont rendu plus de 1 700
décisions fondées sur l'article 101 et/ou l'article 102. Les autorités nationales de concurrence ont
lancé en moyenne 140 enquêtes et adopté 75 décisions chaque année.

[
[podcast ]
][82]

## Cartels & Cie

Cartels & Cie est un podcast dédié aux grandes affaires démantelées par l'Autorité, qui se propose
d'emmener l'auditeur dans les coulisses de ses enquêtes, au cœur de scandales économiques impliquant
des entreprises mondiales.

[
[Guide PME]
][83]

## Espace PME

Dans une démarche de pédagogie, l’Autorité a créé un espace en ligne, intégralement dédié aux PME.
Un guide est mis à leur disposition afin qu'elles connaissent mieux les règles et puissent faire
valoir leurs droits.

Des questions sur vos démarches, des procédures en cours... Contactez-nous !

  Learn how to identify the most common forms of hair loss.
  January 9, 2026
* [6 Common-to-Rare Infant Skin Conditions][63] Various skin disorders occur specifically in
  childhood. Although many of these are benign and self-limited, some require an extensive workup
  and close monitoring.
  January 2, 2026
* [Adult Brain Tumors: A Spreading Problem][64] Adult brain tumors constitute about 2% of all US
  cancers, and about one third of them are malignant. Although some are primary, most arise from
  metastases to the brain. Learn more about risk factors, diagnosis, and treatment of these lesions.
  December 29, 2025
* [Preventive Cardiology in Low-Access Communities][65] Social determinants of health play a
  significant role in the development of risk factors for CVD and are increasingly a target of
  consideration for preventive cardiology interventions.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 26, 2025
* [Community-Acquired Infections][66] Community-acquired infections are contracted outside of
  healthcare settings, significantly impacting daily life. They range from mild illnesses to severe
  diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 13, 2025
* [Can't-Miss Gastrointestinal Diagnoses][67] Determining the exact cause of gastrointestinal
  symptoms can be challenging. Delays in diagnosis and treatment may result in serious
  complications, including abdominal catastrophes.
  November 13, 2025
* [Gout for the Holidays][68] Gout is the most common form of inflammatory arthritis. Once called
  the "disease of kings," gout can result from holiday-related overindulgence in certain foods and
  beverages.
  November 13, 2025
* [In-Flight Emergencies: Practical Medicine and Ethical Considerations][69] As a medical
  professional, what will you do when the airline asks for help for another passenger having a
  medical emergency? Are you prepared?
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 3, 2025
* [Alcohol and Wellness: What's at Stake][70] Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is a prevalent
  substance-abuse condition that affects every organ system.
  October 28, 2025
* [High-Risk ECGs][71] Rapid ECG interpretation is essential in the emergency medicine setting,
  often completed in under 30 seconds. Here, we review a series of ECGs with clinically relevant
  “can’t miss” diagnoses.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, October 21, 2025

Bentham Science is one of the leading publishers specializing in science, technology, and medical
research, providing academic researchers and industrial professionals with the latest information

## **Welcome to Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health**

At Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health, we make it personal — delivering the kind of compassionate
care we would want for ourselves and our families.

By combining compassionate local care with the expertise and resources of Orlando Health, we’re able
to provide patients with expanded access to comprehensive healthcare services throughout the region.

Our providers care for patients across a wide range of specialties, including family medicine,
internal medicine, cardiology, orthopedics, gastroenterology, rheumatology and more.

From preventive care and wellness visits to advanced specialty treatment and chronic condition
management, we’re committed to delivering care that is connected, convenient and centered around
you.

Because healthcare is personal — and we believe your care should be too.

READ MORE +

## Complete Care is Right Around the Corner.

Beyond keeping you healthy, complete care also needs to be convenient. That’s why we have more than
350 medical providers, including primary care and specialists in more than 40 medical disciplines.
And we’re all connected by one electronic health record so any doctor or specialist can access your
medical history at the touch of a button. It’s all about making complete care as accessible and
effortless as it is comprehensive.

## **Welcome to Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health**

At Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health, we make it personal — delivering the kind of compassionate
care we would want for ourselves and our families.

By combining compassionate local care with the expertise and resources of Orlando Health, we’re able
to provide patients with expanded access to comprehensive healthcare services throughout the region.

Our providers care for patients across a wide range of specialties, including family medicine,
internal medicine, cardiology, orthopedics, gastroenterology, rheumatology and more.

From preventive care and wellness visits to advanced specialty treatment and chronic condition
management, we’re committed to delivering care that is connected, convenient and centered around
you.

Because healthcare is personal — and we believe your care should be too.

READ MORE +

## Complete Care is Right Around the Corner.

Beyond keeping you healthy, complete care also needs to be convenient. That’s why we have more than
350 medical providers, including primary care and specialists in more than 40 medical disciplines.
And we’re all connected by one electronic health record so any doctor or specialist can access your
medical history at the touch of a button. It’s all about making complete care as accessible and
effortless as it is comprehensive.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

# ***About Us***

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. specializes in joint diseases, focusing on joint
prostheses, clinical surgical robots, and innovative biomaterials. We are a leading enterprise in
the field of artificial joints in China.

As China's high-tech enterprise, we've been dedicated to technological innovation for years. We have
5 major R&D centers across Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, and the United States. We've also established
the Tianjin Enterprise Key Laboratory and Technology Center to foster industry-academia
collaboration, speeding up the transition of our technological advancements into practical
applications. We are committed to providing safe, effective, and exquisite medical products and
services to the greatest extent possible.

[Read More][61]

Providing safe, effective and exquisite medical products and service.

Sharpen surgeon’s sword to cut off the pain of patients.

Minimally invasive, primary, complex primary, revision, and 3D customized products

prostheses, clinical surgical robots, and innovative biomaterials. We are a leading enterprise in

**Privacy Policy**
**1. General provisions**
1.1 This Personal data processing policy is compiled in accordance with the requirements of the Law
of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V "On Personal Data and their Protection" dated May 21, 2013
and defines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure the security of
personal data of Kazakh Pharmaceutical Company "MEDSERVICE PLUS" LLP (herein – Operator).
1.2 The Operator sets the observance of the rights and freedoms of man and citizen as its most
important goal and condition for the implementation of its activities in the processing of personal
data, including the protection of the rights to privacy, personal and family secrets.
1.3 This Policy regarding the processing of personal data of Operator (herein – Policy) applies to
all information that the Operator can receive about website visitors medservice.kz

**2. Basic concepts used in the Policy**
2.1 Automated processing of personal data – processing of personal data using computer technology;
2.2 Blocking of personal data – temporary termination of processing of personal data (except for
cases when processing is necessary for clarification of personal data);
2.3 Website is a set of graphic and information materials, as well as computer programs and
databases, ensuring their availability on the Internet at the network address medservice.kz;
2.4 Information system of personal data is a set of personal data stored in databases and providing
their processing of information technology and technical means;
2.5 Depersonalization of personal data is actions, as a result of which it is impossible to
determine the belonging of personal data to a specific User or other subject of personal data
without the use of additional information;
2.6 Processing of personal data is any action (operation) or set of actions (operations) with
personal data performed using automation tools or without using such means including collection,
recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, clarification (update, change), extraction, use,
transfer (distribution, provision, access), depersonalization, blocking, deletion, destruction of
personal data;
2.7 Operator is a state body, municipal body, legal or natural person, independently or jointly with
other persons organizing and (or) carrying out the personal data processing, as well as defining the
purposes of processing personal data, the composition of personal data subject to processing,
actions (operations) performed with personal data;
2.8 Personal data are any information related directly or indirectly to a specific or determined
User of medservice.kz website;
2.9 User is any visitor of the medservice.kz website;
2.10 Provision of personal data are actions aimed at disclosing personal data to a certain person or
a certain circle of persons;
2.11 Distribution of personal data are any actions aimed at disclosing personal data to an
indefinite circle of persons (transfer of personal data) or familiarization with personal data of an
unlimited circle of persons, including disclosure of personal data in the media, placement in
information and telecommunication networks or providing access to personal data in any other way;
2.12. Cross-border transfer of personal data is transfer of personal data to the territory of a
foreign state to a foreign state authority, a foreign individual or a foreign legal entity;
2.13 Destruction of personal data is any actions as a result of which personal data are permanently
destroyed with the impossibility of further restoration of the content of personal data in the
personal data information system and (or) as a result of which personal data material carriers are
destroyed.


**3. The Operator can process the following personal data of the User**
- Surname, first name;
- Email address;
- Phone number;
- The site also collects and processes depersonalized data about visitors (including cookies) using
Internet statistics services.
The above-listed data, hereinafter referred to in the text of the Policy by the general concept as
Personal Data.


**4. Personal data processing purposes of**
4.1 The purpose of processing the User's personal data is to inform the User by sending emails.
4.2 The Operator also has the right to send notices to the User about new products and services,
special offers and various events. The User can always refuse to receive informational messages by
sending an email to the Operator at info@medservice.kz email address marked "Refusal of notices
about new products and services and special offers".
4.3 Depersonalized User data collected using Internet statistics services are used to collect
information about User actions on the website, improve the quality of the website and its content.


**5. Legal grounds for processing personal data**
5.1 The Operator processes the User's personal data only if they are filled in and/or sent by the
User independently through special forms located on medservice.kz website. By filling in the
appropriate forms and/or sending the personal data to the Operator, the User agrees with this
Policy.
5.2 The Operator processes depersonalized data about the User if this is allowed in the User's
browser settings (the saving of cookies and the use of JavaScript technology are enabled).


**6. The procedure for collecting, storing, transferring and other types of personal data
processing**
6.1 The safety of personal data processed by the Operator is ensured by implementing legal,
organizational and technical measures necessary to fully comply with the requirements of current
legislation in the field of personal data protection.
6.2 The Operator ensures the safety of personal data and takes all possible measures to prevent
unauthorized persons to access the personal data.
The User's personal data will never, under any circumstances, be transferred to third parties,
except in cases related to the implementation of current legislation.
6.3 In case of inaccuracies in personal data, the User can update them independently by sending a
notice to the Operator to the following email address info@medservice.kz marked "Personal data
update".
6.4 The period of processing the personal data is unlimited. The User can withdraw his/her consent
for the processing of personal data at any time by sending a notice to the Operator via e-mail to
the Operator's info@medservice.kzemail address marked "Withdrawal of consent for the processing of
personal data".


**7. Cross-border transfer of personal data**
7.1 Before initiating the cross-border transfer of personal data, the Operator is obliged to make
sure that the foreign state to whose territory the transfer of personal data is supposed to be
carried out provides reliable protection of the rights of personal data subjects.

**Privacy Policy**
**1. General provisions**
1.1 This Personal data processing policy is compiled in accordance with the requirements of the Law
of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V "On Personal Data and their Protection" dated May 21, 2013
and defines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure the security of
personal data of Kazakh Pharmaceutical Company "MEDSERVICE PLUS" LLP (herein – Operator).
1.2 The Operator sets the observance of the rights and freedoms of man and citizen as its most
important goal and condition for the implementation of its activities in the processing of personal
data, including the protection of the rights to privacy, personal and family secrets.
1.3 This Policy regarding the processing of personal data of Operator (herein – Policy) applies to
all information that the Operator can receive about website visitors medservice.kz

**2. Basic concepts used in the Policy**
2.1 Automated processing of personal data – processing of personal data using computer technology;
2.2 Blocking of personal data – temporary termination of processing of personal data (except for
cases when processing is necessary for clarification of personal data);
2.3 Website is a set of graphic and information materials, as well as computer programs and
databases, ensuring their availability on the Internet at the network address medservice.kz;
2.4 Information system of personal data is a set of personal data stored in databases and providing
their processing of information technology and technical means;
2.5 Depersonalization of personal data is actions, as a result of which it is impossible to
determine the belonging of personal data to a specific User or other subject of personal data
without the use of additional information;
2.6 Processing of personal data is any action (operation) or set of actions (operations) with
personal data performed using automation tools or without using such means including collection,
recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, clarification (update, change), extraction, use,
transfer (distribution, provision, access), depersonalization, blocking, deletion, destruction of
personal data;
2.7 Operator is a state body, municipal body, legal or natural person, independently or jointly with
other persons organizing and (or) carrying out the personal data processing, as well as defining the
purposes of processing personal data, the composition of personal data subject to processing,
actions (operations) performed with personal data;
2.8 Personal data are any information related directly or indirectly to a specific or determined
User of medservice.kz website;
2.9 User is any visitor of the medservice.kz website;
2.10 Provision of personal data are actions aimed at disclosing personal data to a certain person or
a certain circle of persons;
2.11 Distribution of personal data are any actions aimed at disclosing personal data to an
indefinite circle of persons (transfer of personal data) or familiarization with personal data of an
unlimited circle of persons, including disclosure of personal data in the media, placement in
information and telecommunication networks or providing access to personal data in any other way;
2.12. Cross-border transfer of personal data is transfer of personal data to the territory of a
foreign state to a foreign state authority, a foreign individual or a foreign legal entity;
2.13 Destruction of personal data is any actions as a result of which personal data are permanently
destroyed with the impossibility of further restoration of the content of personal data in the
personal data information system and (or) as a result of which personal data material carriers are
destroyed.


**3. The Operator can process the following personal data of the User**
- Surname, first name;
- Email address;
- Phone number;
- The site also collects and processes depersonalized data about visitors (including cookies) using
Internet statistics services.
The above-listed data, hereinafter referred to in the text of the Policy by the general concept as
Personal Data.


**4. Personal data processing purposes of**
4.1 The purpose of processing the User's personal data is to inform the User by sending emails.
4.2 The Operator also has the right to send notices to the User about new products and services,
special offers and various events. The User can always refuse to receive informational messages by
sending an email to the Operator at info@medservice.kz email address marked "Refusal of notices
about new products and services and special offers".
4.3 Depersonalized User data collected using Internet statistics services are used to collect
information about User actions on the website, improve the quality of the website and its content.


**5. Legal grounds for processing personal data**
5.1 The Operator processes the User's personal data only if they are filled in and/or sent by the
User independently through special forms located on medservice.kz website. By filling in the
appropriate forms and/or sending the personal data to the Operator, the User agrees with this
Policy.
5.2 The Operator processes depersonalized data about the User if this is allowed in the User's
browser settings (the saving of cookies and the use of JavaScript technology are enabled).


**6. The procedure for collecting, storing, transferring and other types of personal data
processing**
6.1 The safety of personal data processed by the Operator is ensured by implementing legal,
organizational and technical measures necessary to fully comply with the requirements of current
legislation in the field of personal data protection.
6.2 The Operator ensures the safety of personal data and takes all possible measures to prevent
unauthorized persons to access the personal data.
The User's personal data will never, under any circumstances, be transferred to third parties,
except in cases related to the implementation of current legislation.
6.3 In case of inaccuracies in personal data, the User can update them independently by sending a
notice to the Operator to the following email address info@medservice.kz marked "Personal data
update".
6.4 The period of processing the personal data is unlimited. The User can withdraw his/her consent
for the processing of personal data at any time by sending a notice to the Operator via e-mail to
the Operator's info@medservice.kzemail address marked "Withdrawal of consent for the processing of
personal data".


**7. Cross-border transfer of personal data**
7.1 Before initiating the cross-border transfer of personal data, the Operator is obliged to make
sure that the foreign state to whose territory the transfer of personal data is supposed to be
carried out provides reliable protection of the rights of personal data subjects.
7.2 Cross-border transfer of personal data to the territory of foreign states that do not meet the
above-specified requirements may be carried out only if there is a written consent of the personal
data subject for the cross-border transfer of his/her personal data and/or execution of the
agreement to which the personal data subject is a party.

## Why Healthcare Providers Choose Us

Trusted by thousands of pharmacies and hospitals worldwide.

### Windows & Mac

Runs seamlessly on both Windows and Mac computers. Choose your preferred platform.

### Easy Installation

Quick setup in minutes. Simple installation process with step-by-step guidance.

### Offline & Online

Works offline without internet and syncs when online. Uninterrupted operations guaranteed.

### Built for Global Healthcare

Multi-currency, mobile money integration, and support for 6+ languages to serve diverse markets.

### Mobile Money

Accept MTN, Vodafone, Airtel, M-Pesa, Orange Money, Wave, and more.

### Inventory

Track stock levels, expiry dates, batch numbers, and get low-stock alerts.

### Patient Management

Comprehensive patient records, visit history, vitals tracking, and NHIS integration.

### Lab & Radiology

Integrated lab tests, imaging requests, results tracking, and report generation.

### Analytics

Sales trends, staff performance, inventory valuation, and expense tracking.

### Multi-Branch

Connect multiple workstations and branches with real-time sync.

### User Roles

Admin, Pharmacist, Cashier, and Storekeeper roles with access control.

[About Us][56] [Videos][57] [Resources][58] ## Our Values ### Evidence-Based Every day, about 5,000 scientific papers are published in peer-reviewed medical journals, and groundbreaking nutrition research too often gets lost and buried. We comb through the literature and share practical tips to improve your life. ### Accessible Science is universal, so we are committed to presenting the latest in nutrition and health research in ways that are easy to understand no matter your background or training, in many different languages, and at no cost to you. ### Accountable Corrupting commercial and ideological interests have led to a stew of nutritional misinformation. Don't take anyone's word on something as life-and-death important as what to eat and feed your family. Our videos cite the science and also show the actual studies and link to all the original sources. ### Non-Commercial As a nonprofit organization, we offer a strictly non-commercial public service. The remarkable business foundation of our enterprise was laid by Late Vaidya Shri Bhagat Ram Goel
(BAMS) with the name Sanjivan research laboratories back in the year 1968. The motive behind

healthcare products that treat various ailments. Our company takes extreme pride in having 150
patents and quality herbal formulations in different forms along with 300 traditional pharmacopoeia

medicine's production facility holding GMP and ISO certifications along with FSSAI certification for

appreciated by customers because we stay committed to the factor of quality in production. We

  Maintaining **editorial independence ** and transparency into how we protect the integrity of our

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

[Adalimumab]

Type B (Phuket).

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,

and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
